title: The k-server conjecture is true
summary: A groundbreaking theoretical computer science paper claiming to prove the k-server conjecture, one of the most famous unsolved problems in online algorithms for over three decades. The conjecture, proposed in 1990, states that there exists a deterministic online algorithm for the k-server problem with a competitive ratio of k.
problem_solved: Proves the decades-old k-server conjecture by demonstrating that deterministic k-server algorithms can achieve a competitive ratio of exactly k.
why_valuable: Represents a monumental theoretical breakthrough, resolving a central open problem in online computation that has driven research in algorithm design for over 30 years.
